subject: Centurion RFP: control crosswalk, evidence bundle, and redaction guidance
messages:
From: Ethan Winters <ethan.winters@centurion.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, security@centurion.com
Date: 2028-03-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Centurion RFP - control mapping and evidence request

Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Centurion's security review team has started the RFP deep-dive and attached a control crosswalk template we'd like vendors to complete (we're asking for mappings to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SIG controls) and sample evidence for key controls: authentication, RBAC, KMS usage, telemetry retention, and incident response.

Two asks to start:
- Can you confirm which SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria you map to our SIG questions and provide a completed crosswalk (we prefer a spreadsheet).
- Provide a sample evidence packet (redacted logs, mapping doc, and a network diagram) and any constraints on redaction we should be aware of.

Target: we'd like a first-pass by next Friday 2028-03-09 to include in our vendor comparison.

Laura (procurement) will track procurement/legal items in parallel. If any items require legal redlines or NDA updates, call them out.

Appreciate it — Ethan

Ethan Winters
Senior Information Security Manager
Centurion Financial

Attachment: centurion_crosswalk_template.xlsx (Centurion template)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Winters <ethan.winters@centurion.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@centurion.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Centurion RFP - control mapping and evidence request

Ethan / Laura — thanks for the clear ask. We'll assemble a concise control crosswalk and a curated evidence packet for the controls you flagged. Quick notes up front:

- We can map SIG questions to SOC 2 TSC + ISO 27001 clauses; we'll include the crosswalk in a spreadsheet using your template.
- Evidence: to avoid PII/PHI exposure we'll provide redacted logs and screenshots, a sanitized network diagram, and a signed SOC 2 summary.
- Estimated delivery: initial crosswalk + evidence index by 2028-03-09 EOD Pacific. Full artifact package (larger logs / encrypted archive) can follow by 2028-03-14 if needed.

Looping in Kimberly (Head of Compliance) for the SOC 2 artifact list and Mina (Security Engineer) for the telemetry/log samples and KMS proof.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Winters <ethan.winters@centurion.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@centurion.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Action: Centurion RFP - crosswalk + evidence packet (owners & scope)

Kimberly / Mina — quick kickoff. Ethan asked for a SIG -> SOC2/ISO crosswalk and sample evidence for auth, RBAC, KMS, telemetry retention, and incident response. Please see specific owners and deliverables:

- Kimberly Park: Owner for SOC 2 mapping, evidence index, and SOC 2 summary (deliverable: soc2-summary.pdf, control-mapping.xlsx).
- Mina Haddad: Owner for telemetry/log redaction, KMS proof (kms-key-usage.csv), and sanitized network diagram (network-diagram-2027.pdf). Provide short notes on what we can redact and what we cannot.
- Sergio: I'll assemble the package, add a short README describing redaction and legal considerations, and deliver to their Drive link.

Priority items:
1) Complete Centurion's crosswalk template with our control references.
2) Prepare a zipped evidence packet with redaction instructions and an index file.

Ethan / Laura — we'll upload a first-pass to the Drive link you shared and flag any items that require legal review.

Thanks — Sergio

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Winters <ethan.winters@centurion.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@centurion.com>
Date: 2028-03-08T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action: Centurion RFP - crosswalk + evidence packet (owners & scope)

Team / Ethan — attaching the initial evidence bundle and a short redaction guide. Highlights:

- Attached items (zipped): redwood_soc2_sample_logs.zip (contains redacted auth logs, token rotation snippets, and sample alert traces), kms-key-usage.csv (key rotation and access control audit), network-diagram-2027.pdf (sanitized, shows VPC segmentation but removes internal hostnames).
- Redaction guidance: we replace user identifiers with reversible hashes in logs (we will provide the hash mapping only under NDA). We cannot remove cryptographic key IDs from the KMS usage export because they are required to demonstrate rotation/fidelity; instead, we provide truncated key IDs (first 8 chars) plus an auditor attestation.
- Incident response evidence: included IR playbook excerpt (ir-playbook-excerpt.pdf) and one redacted postmortem (postmortem-sample-redacted.pdf) — timestamps preserved, IPs redacted to /24.

Delivery notes: uploaded first-pass to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cCENTURION_RFP_PACKET.

If Centurion needs raw logs (longer retention windows), we can package and encrypt them for secure transfer; we'd ask for a signed transfer agreement and a narrow retention window.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_sample_logs.zip, kms-key-usage.csv, network-diagram-2027.pdf, ir-playbook-excerpt.pdf, postmortem-sample-redacted.pdf

— Mina Haddad
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Ethan Winters <ethan.winters@centurion.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@centurion.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-10T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Centurion RFP - control crosswalk, evidence bundle, and redaction guidance

Mina / Sergio — thank you, this is very helpful. A few quick follow-ups from our review team:

1) For the kms-key-usage.csv: Can you confirm whether truncated key IDs are sufficient for our internal auditors, or if we need an auditor attestation letter? If an attestation is required, please indicate standard wording.
2) The telemetry sample looks good; can we get a short note on retention policy (default retention, tiers for logs older than 90 days) for our comparison matrix?
3) On redaction: Centurion legal is okay with reversible hashes once we have an NDA/transfer agreement. Please send the minimal agreement template if you have a standard one.

If you can answer the three items above by EOD 2028-03-13 we should be able to include Redwood in our vendor shortlist.

Best,
Ethan

Attachment: centurion_review_notes.docx (inline comments from security team)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Winters <ethan.winters@centurion.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@centurion.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-11T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Centurion RFP - control crosswalk, evidence bundle, and redaction guidance

Ethan — quick answers and next steps:

1) KMS attestation: We include a standard auditor attestation letter for truncated IDs unless Centurion's auditors require raw IDs. I'll attach a template attestation (attestation-template.pdf) and Mina will add suggested wording.
2) Retention policy: Redwood default telemetry retention is 90 days hot, 365 days cold (indexed summaries). We'll provide a one-page retention summary and an export capability note for longer-term archival needs.
3) NDA/transfer: We'll send our minimal transfer agreement (redwood-data-transfer-nnda.docx) for your legal team to review — it's standard for encrypted log handoffs.

I'll upload the attestation template, retention-summary.pdf, and the NNDA to the same Drive folder by EOD today. If you want the reversible hash mapping under NDA, we'll prepare a secure SFTP + key exchange and provide an exact timeline once legal is in place.

Thanks — Sergio

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments (to be uploaded): attestation-template.pdf, retention-summary.pdf, redwood-data-transfer-nnda.docx
